Title: CYP2D6 metabolism
Description: Predicts both inhibition of cytochrome P450 2D6 and whether a molecule serves as its substrate. CYP2D6 is among the most strongly polymorphic drug-metabolising enzymes, and compounds cleared predominantly through it show pronounced inter-individual variability. Gonzalez and co-workers paired a 5,000-compound clearance screen with a luminescent inhibition screen across 2C9, 2D6 and 3A4, using the overlap between readouts to assign labels and reaching balanced accuracies near 0.7. A third of the library proved a 2D6 substrate, and predictions describe enzyme interaction, not overall clearance.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound inhibits CYP2D6 below 10 uM and is cleared within a 30-minute half-life.
